attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Exactly two real-looking humans, natural synthetic color photography, neutral daylight, uncluttered white-background context.
Use this precise Catalan storyboard. Each numbered prompt is a separate panel. Do not print any text.
L’entrepà i les dues carmanyoles. Actors and fixed identity: A = HOME, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant, participant que reparteix; B = DONA, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant, participant que prepara les carmanyoles.
Recurring visual anchors: Dues meitats d’un entrepà amb crosta ondulada i dues carmanyoles amb tapes translúcides de colors diferents.
1. B obre dues carmanyoles sobre la taula mentre A mostra les dues meitats sobre un únic plat.
2. A posa una meitat dins de cada carmanyola. B orienta les frontisses cap a fora.
3. B tanca la primera i A tanca la segona amb les meitats encara visibles a través de la tapa.
4. A i B recullen una carmanyola cadascú i el plat únic queda buit.
attempts.review: A i B intercanvien posició i carmanyola a la tercera vinyeta i tornen a intercanviar-les a la quarta. Els salts fan ambigu a qui correspon cada recipient.

Cast: A is HOME, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is DONA, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
On one clean table, exactly ONE round white plate throughout, two rectangle translucent lunchboxes, BLUE always left, PINK always right, TWO portions of one sandwich. A stays on left and B on right. P1 two halves lie on the ONLY plate, front-center on tabletop, A's hands near that plate while B opens both empty boxes. P2 the two portions are put in the blue and pink lunchboxes, one each, and the SAME single plate is empty now. P3 A closes blue box, B closes pink box, one part seen under each transparent lid. P4 both lift their respective closed boxes, empty plate remaining in place. No extra plates, no hands touching other boxes.
attempts.review: Dues meitats, un plat i dues carmanyoles de colors estables. La dona obre les dues i els dos participants col·laboren directament a omplir, tancar i recollir una cadascú.

alt.es: La mujer abre dos fiambreras. Cada persona coloca una mitad del bocadillo en la suya, la cierra y se la lleva.
